title: Evaluating the trustworthiness of the Fr\'echet Inception Distance with stochastic embedding representations
abstract: arXiv:2601.21979v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Feature embeddings acquired from pretrained models are widely used in medical applications of deep learning to assess the characteristics of datasets; e.g. to determine the quality of synthetic, generated medical images. The Fr\'{e}chet Inception Distance (FID) is one popular synthetic image quality metric that relies on the assumption that the characteristic features of the data can be detected and encoded by an InceptionV3 model pretrained on ImageNet1K (natural images). While it is widely known that this makes it less effective for applications involving medical images, the extent to which the metric fails to capture meaningful differences in image characteristics is not obviously known. Here, we use Monte Carlo dropout to compute the predictive variance in the FID as well as a supplemental estimate of the predictive variance in the feature embedding model's latent representations. translated_title: 评估基于随机嵌入表示的弗雷歇初始距离的可信度
translated_abstract: 摘要：从预训练模型中获取的特征嵌入广泛用于深度学习的医学应用中，以评估数据集的特征，例如确定生成的合成医学图像的质量。弗雷歇初始距离（FID）是一种流行的合成图像质量指标，它依赖于数据特征能够被在ImageNet1K（自然图像）上预训练的InceptionV3模型检测和编码的假设。虽然众所周知，这使得它在涉及医学图像的应用中效果较差，但该指标未能捕捉图像特征中有意义差异的程度尚不明确。在此，我们使用蒙特卡洛丢弃法计算FID中的预测方差，以及特征嵌入模型潜在表示中预测方差的补充估计。我们表明，预测方差的幅度...
tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛丢弃法评估FID在医学图像中的预测方差，揭示其可信度受嵌入表示随机性影响。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates the trustworthiness of FID in medical images by computing predictive variance via Monte Carlo dropout, revealing its reliability is affected by stochastic embedding representations.
